plan.name: Bind current bugs to mandatory TLC replay paths
plan.summary: Add optional bug-only code_behavior values current and hypothetical to ratified statements, require every bug in a newly submitted modeled proposal or preview to be classified, direct formalization to classify bugs reported by the issue, unchanged code or tests as current, and show additions, changes and removals of classification in proposals and amendment comparisons while preserving omitted-field serialization and legacy proposal hashes. Retain each current bug's fresh TLC counterexample independently of outDir, including temporal loops and stuttering, and derive a deterministic complete ordered request bound to the exact statement, expected violation, proposal, staged model and sibling includes, ratified bounds and pinned tools, using lossless typed values and TLC-established action arguments for every edge; refuse malformed or ambiguous interpretations and explicitly report replay-unsupported-temporal for temporal counterexamples this executable replay contract cannot check. Implement and test the version 1 request/result and independent observation contract specified by the acceptance sources: the gate owns the path and verdict, requires the exact initial state and every setup call before an actually dispatched offending operation, checks any returned alternative or normal refusal against the model, and rejects reproduced bugs, fabricated refusals, exceptions, incomplete execution, substituted paths and stale identities. Connect mandatory obligations to ordinary and existing-application driver gates regardless of sampling budgets, missing adapters or driver options, or exhaustive declarations, with replay-unavailable until the following parent steps provide execution adapters; model-only checks prepare obligations without code execution, Go agreement/exploration remains unchanged, legacy and hypothetical bugs keep their existing model-strength checks without replay calls or counts, and JSON, Markdown, feedback and dashboard evidence distinguish caught bugs from pending or failed replay while showing legacy bugs as 'not replayed: not classified', preserving independent proof/model evidence and fingerprinting stable replay inputs and results rather than private paths or invocation IDs. Update only the unratified proposal fixtures and the dashboard assertion whose wording changes, retain the existing unclassified Python admission/design-obligation fixtures and all their refusal cases, add pinned-TLC extraction regressions in the existing integration lane, and update SPEC.md with a citation to #857's ratified plan, docs/gate.md with the delivered replay contract and temporary unavailability, docs/factory.md with classification and ratification semantics, and the README's short gate explanation and receipt example; the merger records the new classification, compatibility and replay-evidence decisions, and this plumbing build changes no existing pinned statements, ratified.lock files or decisions/ records.

tests.name: TestBugClassificationIsRatifiedWithoutRehashingLegacy857
tests.says: Current, hypothetical and omitted classification have distinct ratification identities, while the exact legacy JSON and hash stay unchanged.

tests.name: TestBugClassificationValidationKeepsLegacyLocks857
tests.says: Only bugs accept current or hypothetical code_behavior; legacy omission is valid for locks and unknown values are refused.

tests.name: TestNewProposalsMustClassifyBugs857
tests.says: New modeled drafts reject missing classifications and the prompt directs classification from the issue, unchanged code and tests.

tests.name: TestClassificationChangesAreVisibleStatementAmendments857
tests.says: Changing or removing classification changes the proposal hash and is a direct statement amendment even when TLA+ and prose are identical.

tests.name: TestProposalAndRatificationBindBugClassification857
tests.says: Proposal and amendment comments show classifications and ratification rejects reclassification or removal under the old hash.

tests.name: TestScopeRejectsReclassificationUnderOldRatification857
tests.says: The scope check refuses an amendment that changes classification after the proposal was ratified.

tests.name: TestReplayValuesPreserveTypesAndExactIntegers857
tests.says: Replay encoding preserves model values, strings, sets, ordered sequences, typed function keys and exact integers through JSON and TLA+, rejecting ambiguous or malformed values without changing the display parser.

tests.name: TestReplayPathsUseEveryCheckedParameterizedEdge857
tests.says: TLC establishes every action and argument in two independently bound complete paths, including repeated actions, despite misleading display labels; retained paths own their states and source/tool identities.

tests.name: TestReplayPathsRefuseMalformedAmbiguousAndTemporalEvidence857
tests.says: Missing, duplicate, malformed, ambiguous or nonmatching edge evidence cannot become a replay request, and temporal loop/stutter obligations fail explicitly without losing their infinite-behavior information.

tests.name: TestCurrentBugsBlockDriverGatesAndRetainIndependentPaths857
tests.says: Two current bugs retain separate fresh counterexamples and complete requests even without outDir, and replay-unavailable blocks sampled and exhaustive driver gates while successful independent checks survive.

tests.name: TestModelOnlyPreparesCurrentReplayWithoutCode857
tests.says: Model-only checks remain successful when the model catches the bugs, prepare pending current-bug obligations, and never execute code or claim replay.

tests.name: TestLegacyAndMixedBugsKeepModelChecksWithoutInventedReplays857
tests.says: Legacy sampled gates pass with no replay calls, model-strength failures still fail, unclassified neighbors cannot hide a current obligation, hypothetical bugs need no replay, and Go's existing proof/agreement path stays unchanged.

tests.name: TestLegacySampledExistingPythonStillPassesAndDoesNotReplay857
tests.says: Unchanged existing Python fixtures in legacy and explicit-component modes still pass, retain model-strength refusals, and label their unclassified bugs without requesting replay.

tests.name: TestReplayResultRequiresActualOrderedOffendingCall857
tests.says: Versioned result validation requires matching independent actual-call observations and the full prefix, accepts only a checked normal refusal or model-allowed alternative, and rejects fabricated, stale, incomplete, divergent or reproduced results.

tests.name: TestReplayIdentityAndFingerprintsBindStableEvidence857
tests.says: Request identity binds stable owned inputs, invocation identity is fresh, fingerprints include classification/path/tool/bounds/result changes and exclude transient invocation IDs and private trace paths.

tests.name: TestBugReceiptSeparatesModelAndReplayEvidence857
tests.says: Markdown and JSON distinguish model catches, unavailable current replays and hypothetical bugs, label legacy bugs exactly, count none as replayed, and preserve proof evidence and JSON-round-trip fingerprints.

tests.name: TestDashboardDistinguishesBugDetectionFromReplay857
tests.says: Dashboard rule cards, proposal rules and project API expose classification and unmet replay separately from Caught, including the exact legacy non-replay label.
